Boundary flags and drift summaries make date changes reviewable. These
functions compare civil-date values; they do not infer time zones or parse
ambiguous timestamps.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(jwcalendarR)
```

```{r}
boundary_scan("2024-02-25", "2024-03-03")
date_drift("2024-02-28", "2024-02-29")
calendar_test_vectors(c(1900, 2000, 2024))
explain_date("2024-12-31")
```

`tools/validate-heavy.R` is a separate, manually run 400-year deterministic
validation script. Examples and ordinary package tests stay bounded and local.
